functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION chat_activity_private.can_use(p_conversation_id uuid, p_sending boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.conversations c WHERE c.id=p_conversation_id
   AND NOT coalesce(c.is_note,false)
   AND CASE WHEN coalesce(c.is_group,false) THEN
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.conversation_members m WHERE m.conversation_id=c.id AND m.user_id=auth.uid())
    AND (NOT p_sending OR public.can_send_in_conversation(c.id))
   ELSE (auth.uid()=c.user1_id OR auth.uid()=c.user2_id)
    AND NOT public.is_blocked_between(c.user1_id,c.user2_id) END
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION chat_activity_private.can_read_receipt(p_message_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.messages m JOIN public.conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id
  WHERE m.id=p_message_id AND CASE
   WHEN coalesce(c.is_note,false) THEN c.owner_id=auth.uid()
   WHEN coalesce(c.is_group,false) THEN EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM public.conversation_members cm WHERE cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=auth.uid())
   ELSE (c.user1_id=auth.uid() OR c.user2_id=auth.uid())
    AND NOT public.is_blocked_between(c.user1_id,c.user2_id) END
 );
$function$

functions.name: get_chat_activity
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_chat_activity(p_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF chat_activity
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.can_read_chat_activity(p_conversation_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Activity unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT a.* FROM public.chat_activity a WHERE a.conversation_id=p_conversation_id
  AND a.active AND a.expires_at > statement_timestamp();
END;
$function$

functions.name: can_join_chat_activity
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_join_chat_activity(p_topic text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_topic ~ '^chat-activity-db:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
  THEN public.can_read_chat_activity(substr(p_topic,18)::uuid) ELSE false END;
$function$

functions.name: update_group_info
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION chat_activity_private.update_group_info(p_conversation_id uuid, p_name text, p_description text, p_avatar text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_role text; v_permission text;
BEGIN
 SELECT m.role,coalesce(c.permissions->>'edit_group_info','admins') INTO v_role,v_permission
 FROM public.conversation_members m JOIN public.conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id
 WHERE m.conversation_id=p_conversation_id AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND c.is_group AND NOT coalesce(c.is_note,false) FOR UPDATE OF m;
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_role IS NULL OR (v_permission<>'everyone' AND v_role NOT IN ('owner','admin')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Group edit not authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 UPDATE public.conversations SET group_name=coalesce(p_name,group_name),group_description=coalesce(p_description,group_description),
 group_avatar=coalesce(p_avatar,group_avatar),updated_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=p_conversation_id;
END $function$
